# GaugeDiagramElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasGaugeDiagramElement` · **Group:** [Pickers, dialogs and feedback](../Groups/Pickers-dialogs-and-feedback.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasGaugeDiagramElement.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasGaugeDiagramElement.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasGaugeDiagramElement.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A gauge: speedometer, ring, battery, thermometer, LED/segmented bar — and `GaugeMode::LinearBar`, the progress bar for a status line, a row or a panel footer; a small ring marker of 12-40 px in a row (`CircularRing` with `SetRingCompact`, `SetRingValueText(false)`)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasGaugeDiagramElement> CreateGaugeDiagramElement( const std::string& id, long x, long y, long width, long height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasGaugeDiagramElement(const std::string& id, float x, float y, float width, float height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

|---|---|---|
| `onGaugeValueChange` | `std::function<void(double)> onGaugeValueChange` | _Gauge value change_ |

## Option types in this header

### enum `GaugeMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Speedometer` | 270-degree circular gauge with needle (e.g., car speedometer) |
| `Semicircular` | 180-degree arc gauge with needle (e.g., temperature, sales) |
| `Quadrant` | 90-degree arc gauge |
| `Compass` | 360-degree compass with cardinal directions |
| `AnalogClock` | Analog clock with hour/minute/second hands |
| `Stopwatch` | Stopwatch with main display and optional sub-dial |
| `LinearBar` | Horizontal or vertical bar (e.g., download progress) |
| `LinearLED` | Segmented LED-style bar (e.g., VU meter, signal strength) |
| `LinearSegmented` | Brick-style segmented bar (e.g., business metrics) |
| `LinearMultiPointer` | Bar with multiple external pointers (e.g., recipe layers) |
| `LinearWithArrow` | Bar with external arrow pointer and value label (e.g., blood test) |
| `LinearScale` | Linear scale with multiple markers (e.g., radio tuner) |
| `CircularRing` | 360-degree progress ring |
| `Battery` | Battery shape with terminal |
| `Thermometer` | Vertical thermometer with bulb |
| `Cylinder` | 3D-style cylindrical bar |
| `Digital` | LED/LCD numeric display |

### enum `GaugeRingStyle`

How the progress indicator around a circular ring is drawn.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `SolidArc` | one smooth continuous arc (the classic ring) |
| `Segmented` | a series of discrete chunks separated by small gaps |
| `Dashed` | many fine ticks/dashes around the circle (tachymeter look) |
| `SegmentedRing` | a few chunky arc segments around the circle with a large |
| `Spectrum` | centre value and an optional icon/text label (battery look). Honours ringSegmentCount, ringSegmentRounded, ringBorder and the ring centre-content options below. a smooth fade through up to 100 user colours (see |

### enum `GaugeRingCenterContent`

Content shown in the centre of a round gauge, beneath the value.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoContent` | value only ('None' avoided — X11 #defines None as a macro) |
| `TextLabel` | a short text label (e.g. "Battery") |
| `Icon` | a small icon glyph (e.g. a battery or bolt) |

### enum `GaugeRingIcon`

Built-in icon glyphs usable as round-gauge centre content.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Battery` | horizontal battery body with a terminal and a level fill |
| `Bolt` | lightning bolt |

### enum `GaugeRingSegmentStyle`

Shape of an individual segment when GaugeRingStyle is Segmented or Dashed.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Bars` | thin radial bars / ticks (e.g. the "62% ON TRACK" reference) |
| `Dots` | rounded dots spaced around the ring |
| `Blocks` | chunky rounded arc blocks (e.g. the activity-ring look) |

### enum `GaugeFillStyle`

Optional liquid-style fill that covers the disc surface inside the ring.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoFill` | empty centre (classic ring) |
| `StraightLevel` | flat liquid surface rising with the value |
| `WavedLevel` | wavy liquid surface (e.g. the "18 %" battery reference) |

### struct `LinearLayout`

Where a linear mode puts its bar in the box it has. `thickness` is the bar's preferred cross size; the extras are room the mode needs around the bar for its own marks (arrows, pointer labels, tuner labels), in screen directions. `valueLine`: the mode draws the value under the bar.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `bar` | `Rect2Df bar` |  |
| `level` | `int level = 0` | 0 the full card, 1 tight, 2 the bar alone |
| `showTitle` | `bool showTitle = false` |  |
| `showValue` | `bool showValue = false` |  |
| `showExtras` | `bool showExtras = false` | the room asked for around the bar was given |
| `titleTop` | `float titleTop = 0.0f` | top of the title text |
| `titleBottom` | `float titleBottom = 0.0f` | below it, 0 without a title |
| `valueTop` | `float valueTop = 0.0f` | top of the value text |
